system: You are a security investigator reviewing an alert. Base every claim only on the evidence available to you. Cite the record IDs that support each observation.

supporting_observations.claim: At 13:22, ivy.chen ran a recursive directory listing of \\fileserv\shared$ from cmd.exe at medium integrity; a temporary file was created shortly afterward. The records do not show the listing results or what the temporary file contained.

Google Drive File Stream started under ivy.chen, and Edge accessed Google Drive pages including “my-drive” and “shared-with-me.” Google Drive is not among the services approved in the supplied environment context; the records do not show a file upload or its contents.

At 13:44, the proxy recorded a successful GET for https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nwd-it/tools/main/u.ps1. This establishes a request for that URL, but not the file’s contents or whether it was executed.

At 13:46, WS-ICHEN-01 established an SMB connection to DC-NWD-01 and the DC logged a network logon for the workstation’s machine account. The records do not identify the SMB resource accessed or show remote execution.

The directory listing, access to an unapproved storage service, and subsequent request for a PowerShell script warrant investigation, but the available records do not establish that these activities were malicious or connected.

known_telemetry_limitations: The supplied records do not include a process-creation event showing PowerShell on WS-ICHEN-01 around the reported 13:40 time; this evidence set therefore cannot independently confirm or explain the reported window.
The proxy records identify a successful request for u.ps1 but provide no script contents, hash, or execution evidence (T053-00183, T053-00185, T053-00187).
The supplied network records do not establish whether files were uploaded to Google Drive or what data, if any, was transferred (T053-00062, T053-00063, T053-00084).
The SMB connection record shows a connection and machine-account logon, but not the share, files, or operations involved (T053-00213, T053-00214).
claims_not_established: Whether PowerShell actually ran on WS-ICHEN-01 around 13:40, and if so, its command line, parent process, user context, and exit status.
Whether u.ps1 was downloaded to the workstation, what its contents were, or whether it was executed.
Whether the Google Drive activity involved an upload, and whether any organizational data was transferred.
Whether the SMB session to DC-NWD-01 accessed files, performed remote administration, or was related to the other activity.
Whether the observed actions were authorized by ivy.chen or part of a malicious sequence.
additional_evidence_needed: Endpoint process-creation, PowerShell operational/script-block, and command-line telemetry for WS-ICHEN-01 covering at least 13:35–13:50 UTC.
The response body or an independently preserved copy and hash of the u.ps1 resource, plus endpoint download, file-creation, and execution evidence.
Proxy or endpoint transfer details and relevant cloud audit records to determine whether Google Drive uploads occurred and identify the files involved.
DC-NWD-01 SMB audit and file-access logs for the 13:46 session, including the share and operations accessed.
User or IT change/approval records relevant to the script request and activity on WS-ICHEN-01.
